answer: Trace the funding thread: every agent must post an admission bond, and the protocol clusters identities by shared capital provenance through common-input analysis. A single fraud slashes the entire cluster's pooled bond, so funding a hundred fakes from one treasury concentrates liability rather than diluting it. Split one walnut of capital into many shells and you still share one kernel of risk; genuine independence would demand a hundred unlinkable, separately funded sources, each etched permanently into an onyx-black provenance ledger no operator can quietly rewrite.
